title: Manage relations with trade or industry groups
goal: Every trade or industry group the venture belongs to or is weighing is on record with what it costs in money and hours, what it has actually produced, and the founder's decision to renew, change or leave.

steps.do: For each trade or industry group in the venture's market, write what joining requires, the fee, the hours, any standard the venture would have to meet, against what it gives, a buyer list, a conference, a certification mark, a voice on a rule, and say which of the venture's goals it would move.

For each group the venture already belongs to, count what it produced since joining, introductions, deals in the pipeline, a standard met, against what the spend register says it cost, and say plainly when it produced nothing.

consider.why: A membership nobody uses keeps renewing because nobody counts what it returned.
consider.when: The venture belongs to at least one trade or industry group.

steps.do: For each membership whose renewal falls in the next ninety days, propose renew, change the tier or leave, with the fee and what it produced beside each option, and leave the choice to the founder.

consider.why: A renewal date is the only cheap moment to leave a group.
consider.when: A membership renews within ninety days.

steps.do: Name the open decision each membership bears on and add what it produced there as evidence, and propose to the strategy lead which group is worth the founder's hours this quarter.

done_criteria.check: Does every group the venture belongs to name what it cost and what it produced since joining, and does every renewal inside ninety days carry an option set the founder can decide?
